title: Joe’s Soap Boat

scenes.summary: Joe sees his soap boat sailing away and feels worried.
scenes.text: My soap boat is sailing away! cries Joe.
scenes.image_prompt: young boy on beach watching a small soap boat float away in water, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: The soap boat drifts into the sea and gets lost.
scenes.text: The soap boat is lost in the sea.
scenes.image_prompt: small soap boat floating far into the sea waves, distant shore, bright cartoon style

scenes.summary: Sea creatures notice the strange soap boat underwater.
scenes.text: What is this? says a fish. A whale is under the water.
scenes.image_prompt: curious fish and a large whale underwater looking at a floating soap boat, colorful cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: The soap boat floats up and is grabbed and dropped by a bird.
scenes.text: The soap boat floats on top. A bird grabs the soap boat. The bird drops the soap boat.
scenes.image_prompt: bird picking up a small soap boat above water and dropping it near the shore, playful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Joe gets his soap boat back and feels happy.
scenes.text: It’s my soap boat! says Joe.
scenes.image_prompt: happy child holding recovered soap boat on beach with smiling parent nearby, colorful cartoon style

story: My soap boat is sailing away! cries Joe. The soap boat is lost in the sea. What is this? says a fish. A whale is under the water. The soap boat floats on top. A bird grabs the soap boat. The bird drops the soap boat. It’s my soap boat! says Joe.
